speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I understand you have been experiencing a long-standing itchy rash, along with numbness and tingling sensations in your palms. To help me pinpoint the cause, could you describe exactly what the rash looks like and how long you have had these symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Pityriasis Lichenoides Chronica (PLC) with associated neuropathy.

The patient's history of a one-year itchy rash on the upper body and face, combined with numbness and tingling in the palms while working on a rice farm with livestock, suggests a chronic inflammatory dermatosis potentially triggered by an environmental agent or an underlying systemic condition. The neurological symptoms may be due to peripheral neuropathy related to the systemic nature of the disease or a separate issue.

To confirm the diagnosis and rule out other causes, I need to see the rash and check for any underlying systemic involvement. REQUEST IMAGES: Skin_biopsy. REQUEST TEST: CBC_with_differential, ESR, and ANA.
